card.title: RAF BUFFALO Mk I
card.flavorText: The Brewster Buffalo Mk I was the British designation of the American Brewster F2A Buffalo, a fighter aircraft that was introduced in 1939 and used in service by the US and Allied air forces early in WWII.  At the start of the war the British and Commonwealth forces were in desperate need of fighter aircraft and ordered the Buffalo to use in the Far East only as it was deemed unfit for service in the West. The Buffalo was considered both unstable and overweight in comparison to the Axis aircraft, especially the Japanese Mitsubishi A6M Zero, and would soon make way for the Hawker Hurricane which was a great improvement over the Buffalo. From 1942 most Buffalo’s in British service were pulled from the frontline and for training purposes.
